item.title: 45k-Mile 1989 Mercury Cougar XR-7 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1989 Mercury Cougar XR7 spent time with a single family in Montana prior to the seller's acquisition in 2020, and it now shows 45k miles. It is powered by a supercharged 3.8-liter V6 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Oxford White over red leather upholstery. item.title: 21-Years-Owned 2003 Toyota Celica GT-S 6-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 2003 Toyota Celica GT-S was acquired by the seller in 2004, and it now has 52k miles. Power is provided by a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-four linked with a six-speed manual transaxle, and the body is finished in black over black cloth upholstery. Equipment includes the Action Package, a sunroof, HID headlights, a rear wing, 16" alloy wheels, cruise control, power windows, air conditioning, and a JVC head unit linked to a JBL sound system. item.description: This 1994 Toyota HiAce Super Custom Limited is a right-hand-drive van that was imported to the US following the selling dealer's acquisition in 2025. item.title: 1966 Mercedes-Benz 230SL at No Reserve
item.description: This 1966 Mercedes-Benz 230SL is powered by a 2.3-liter inline-six paired with a four-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Signal Red over black MB-Tex. Equipment includes a black convertible top, a removable hardtop, power steering, 14" steel wheels with painted covers, an AM/FM radio, and a heater. It was acquired in 2021 by the seller, the Petersen Automotive Museum of Los Angeles, California. This W113 SL is now offered at no reserve with a California title in the museum's name.

item.title: 1961 Aston Martin DB4 Series II
item.description: This 1961 Aston Martin DB4 was configured in left-hand-drive for the North American market and was shipped on December 2, 1960, to J.S. Inskip Inc. in New York. Chassis 496/L is said to have remained under original ownership in New York through the late 1980s, during which time it was retrofitted with a sunroof.
